question: A sum of Rs. 1,00,000 was taken from a bank at the rate of 7% p.a to be compounded annually for 5 years. Calculate the compound interest. (Closest to a Rs.)
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = 100000

Rate of interest (R) = 7%

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + (R% / 100))T

Compound Interest (CI) = A - P
